Estimate required thermal time from observed planting and harvest dates

Source: R/ThermoPheno_functions.R
estimate_required_tt_from_observed.Rd

For each observed season, thermal time is accumulated from the observed planting date to the observed harvest date (both inclusive). The required thermal time is the median (or mean) of these seasonal sums.

Usage

estimate_required_tt_from_observed(
  weather,
  observed_calendar,
  calibration_years,
  planting_col = "observed_planting_date",
  harvest_col = "observed_harvest_date",
  year_col = "crop_year",
  t_base,
  t_opt = NA_real_,
  t_max_cut = NA_real_,
  tt_mode = "simple",
  summary_fun = c("median", "mean"),
  min_weather_coverage = 0.95,
  crop_type = c("summer", "winter"),
  winter_dormancy_temp = 0,
  vernalization_required = FALSE,
  vernalization_temp_min = 0,
  vernalization_temp_max = 10,
  vernalization_days_required = 30,
  spring_regrowth_temp = 5,
  accumulation = c("simulation", "raw")
)

Arguments

weather

Prepared weather data from prepare_weather().

observed_calendar

Data frame with observed planting and harvest dates.

calibration_years

Years used for thermal-time calibration.

planting_col

Name of observed planting-date column.

harvest_col

Name of observed harvest-date column.

year_col

Name of crop-year column.

t_base

Base temperature.

t_opt

Optimum temperature.

t_max_cut

Upper temperature cutoff.

tt_mode

Thermal-time method: simple, capped, or triangular.

summary_fun

Summary method for annual TT values: median or mean.

min_weather_coverage

Minimum fraction of daily weather records required.

crop_type

summer or winter. Selects the accumulation rules used with accumulation = "simulation"; pass the same value as to the simulation.

winter_dormancy_temp, vernalization_required, vernalization_temp_min, vernalization_temp_max, vernalization_days_required, spring_regrowth_temp

Winter-crop rules, as in simulate_one_year(). Pass the values used for the simulation. Ignored for summer crops and with accumulation = "raw".

accumulation

simulation (default) accumulates thermal time with the simulation rules; raw reproduces the 0.1.1 raw sum. See the Accumulation section.

Value

A list containing yearly observed TT values and the estimated required TT, plus the accumulation and crop_type used.

Accumulation

With accumulation = "simulation" (the default), each season is accumulated with the same code and rules that simulate_one_year() uses after planting: the thermal-time method and, for crop_type = "winter", the vernalization and dormancy rules. A requirement calibrated this way is reached by the simulation on the observed harvest date when the simulation is started on the observed planting date of the same season.

With accumulation = "raw", the daily thermal time is summed over the observed interval without the winter-crop rules. This reproduces ThermoPheno 0.1.1. For winter crops with vernalization, the raw sum is larger than what the simulation accumulates over the same interval, so a raw requirement is systematically too high for the simulation to reach on time.

For summer crops (the default crop_type), both settings sum the same daily values, so calls written for ThermoPheno 0.1.1 return the same values up to floating-point rounding (the simulation adds day by day in double precision; the raw sum uses sum()). That rounding difference could, in 0.1.1, place a simulated maturity one day after the observed harvest date of a calibration season.
